records.jp: 星崎さん。<CR>ここは私のお気に入りの場所なんです
records.en_original: This is one of my very favorite places.
records.en_auxiliary: This is one of my very favorite places.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san.<CR>This is one of my favorite places.

records.jp: そうなんだ！<CR>詩さんのお気に入り、教えてもらえて嬉しい！
records.en_original: Really? I'm glad that you'd share something like that with me!
records.en_auxiliary: Really? I'm glad that you'd share something like that with me!
records.en: Really?<CR>I'm glad you shared one of your favorite places with me, Uta-san!

records.jp: 私も何となくだけど、ここって好きだよ
records.en_original: I like it quite a bit myself.
records.en_auxiliary: I like it quite a bit myself.
records.en: I like it quite a bit myself.

records.jp: どんなところが好きか、聞いてもいいですか？
records.en_original: May I ask what you like about it?
records.en_auxiliary: May I ask what you like about it?
records.en: May I ask what you like about it?

records.jp: やっぱ、この雰囲気かな。<CR>街燈のレトロ感が、なんだか落ち着く～
records.en_original: The atmosphere, I think. Something about the retro vibe is really calming.
records.en_auxiliary: The atmosphere, I think. Something about the retro vibe is really calming.
records.en: The atmosphere, I think.<CR>Something about the retro vibe is really calming.

records.jp: ……レトロ感、ですか？
records.en_original: ...Retro vibe?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Retro vibe?
records.en: ...Retro vibe?

records.jp: あ。もしかして私、適当なこと言っちゃった？
records.en_original: Oh. Did I say something silly?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh. Did I say something silly?
records.en: Oh. Did I say something silly?

records.jp: いえ。<CR>私もこの街燈に懐かしさを感じるのですが……
records.en_original: No, I think I understand what you mean. I feel the same.
records.en_auxiliary: No, I think I understand what you mean. I feel the same.
records.en: No,<CR>I think I understand what you mean. I feel the same.

records.jp: 何がそう感じさせるのかを、<CR>私も考えてみようと思いまして
records.en_original: I have been thinking about why this place makes me feel so nostalgic.
records.en_auxiliary: I have been thinking about why this place makes me feel so nostalgic.
records.en: I have been thinking about why<CR>this place makes me feel so nostalgic.

records.jp: そっか。詩さんもここで懐かしさを感じるんだ！
records.en_original: So that's how it makes you feel, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: So that's how it makes you feel, huh?
records.en: I see. You feel nostalgic here too, Uta-san!

records.jp: うーん。強いて言えば、街燈の形？<CR>昔の映画に出てくるみたいな
records.en_original: Hmm. I guess if I have to choose something, it's the shape of the lamps? They're like something out of an old movie.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. I guess if I have to choose something, it's the shape of the lamps? They're like something out of an old movie.
records.en: Hmm. I guess if I have to choose something, it's the shape of the lamps?<CR>They're like something out of an old movie.

records.jp: ……そうですね。<CR>今はなかなか見ない形だと思います
records.en_original: ...Yes, they are quite unusual.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes, they are quite unusual.
records.en: Yes.<CR>I think it is a shape one rarely sees now.

records.jp: 最新のカッコいいデザインもいいけど、<CR>こういう古い形って、なんだかほっとするなぁ
records.en_original: The latest designs are cool, but there's something nice about the old-fashioned ones.
records.en_auxiliary: The latest designs are cool, but there's something nice about the old-fashioned ones.
records.en: The latest designs are cool,<CR>but there's something nice about the old-fashioned ones.

records.jp: ほっとする……んですか？<CR>不格好、ではなくて？
records.en_original: Nice? You don't find them unattractive?
records.en_auxiliary: Nice? You don't find them unattractive?
records.en: Nice?<CR>You don't find them unattractive?

records.jp: 不格好だとかは思わないかなぁ。<CR>どっちかっていうと、優しい形だなって思うよ
records.en_original: I don't think so. Something about their shape is...calming.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think so. Something about their shape is...calming.
records.en: I would not call it unattractive.<CR>If anything, I think it has a gentle shape.

records.jp: 私には、「優しい形」なのかは分かりません。<CR>でも、見ていると穏やかな気持ちになれます
records.en_original: I don't think I understand what you mean. Though, I do feel somehow soothed looking at them.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I understand what you mean. Though, I do feel somehow soothed looking at them.
records.en: I don't think I understand what you mean.<CR>Though, I do feel somehow soothed looking at them.

records.jp: 穏やかな気持ちかぁ……
records.en_original: Soothed, huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Soothed, huh...
records.en: Soothed, huh...

records.jp: ……多分ですが、私はこうした街燈を<CR>見たことがあって、好きだったんだと思います
records.en_original: I must have seen something like these at some point. I believe I was fond of them.
records.en_auxiliary: I must have seen something like these at some point. I believe I was fond of them.
records.en: I must have seen something like these at some point.<CR>I believe I was fond of them.

records.jp: 実物なのか、映像や写真なのかは<CR>覚えていないんですが……
records.en_original: Though I'm not sure if it was in person, or simply in a picture or movie.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I'm not sure if it was in person, or simply in a picture or movie.
records.en: Though I'm not sure if it was in person,<CR>or simply in a picture or movie.

records.jp: へぇ……なんか、そういうの、かっこいいなぁ
records.en_original: Huh... You make it sound so cool.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... You make it sound so cool.
records.en: Huh... You make it sound so cool.

records.jp: この街燈って、実際すごく雰囲気あるけどさ、<CR>詩さんは、どんなものを連想する？
records.en_original: They do have a particular atmosphere, does it bring anything to mind for you?
records.en_auxiliary: They do have a particular atmosphere, does it bring anything to mind for you?
records.en: These streetlights really do have atmosphere.<CR>What do they make you think of, Uta-san?

records.jp: 連想……ですか？<CR>強いて言えば……19世紀のロンドン、でしょうか
records.en_original: What does it bring to mind? I suppose...nineteenth-century London?
records.en_auxiliary: What does it bring to mind? I suppose...nineteenth-century London?
records.en: What does it bring to mind?<CR>I suppose...nineteenth-century London?

records.jp: へぇ。なんだかロマンチックだね。<CR>……って、19世紀のロンドンって、どんなやつ？
records.en_original: Ooh, sounds romantic. What was nineteenth-century London like, anyway?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, sounds romantic. What was nineteenth-century London like, anyway?
records.en: Ooh, sounds romantic.<CR>What was nineteenth-century London like, anyway?

records.jp: 産業革命が盛んになった頃で……そうですね。<CR>蒸気機関車が走っていた時代です
records.en_original: It was the height of the Industrial Revolution. There were steam locomotives running then.
records.en_auxiliary: It was the height of the Industrial Revolution. There were steam locomotives running then.
records.en: It was the height of the Industrial Revolution.<CR>There were steam locomotives running then.

records.jp: 蒸気機関車かぁ……！<CR>蒸気機関車っていえば……
records.en_original: Steam locomotives?
records.en_auxiliary: Steam locomotives?
records.en: Steam<CR>locomotives?

records.jp: やっぱレトロで懐かしいイメージだよね！<CR>いちど乗ってみたいなぁ……
records.en_original: So retro! I'd love to ride one someday!
records.en_auxiliary: So retro! I'd love to ride one someday!
records.en: So retro!<CR>I'd love to ride one someday!

records.jp: でも、蒸気機関車の動力は、石炭です。<CR>機関車の煙にはすすが大量に含まれていて……
records.en_original: But steam locomotives ran on coal. There would be so much smoke and soot...
records.en_auxiliary: But steam locomotives ran on coal. There would be so much smoke and soot...
records.en: But steam locomotives ran on coal.<CR>There would be so much smoke and soot...

records.jp: そのすすが窓から大量に――
records.en_original: I heard that the soot would flow in endlessly through the windows.
records.en_auxiliary: I heard that the soot would flow in endlessly through the windows.
records.en: And large amounts of that soot would come in through the windows—

records.jp: ま、待った！　なんとなく分かった。<CR>つまり、のんびりしたイメージってより……
records.en_original: Okay, okay! I think I get the picture. You're saying it's not the nice leisure ride I think it is...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay, okay! I think I get the picture. You're saying it's not the nice leisure ride I think it is...
records.en: Okay, okay! I think I get the picture.<CR>You're saying it's not the nice leisure ride I think it is...

records.jp: 窓を開けると、顔など真っ黒になるそうですし、<CR>健康被害もあったようですよ
records.en_original: Opening a window would end up with your face stained black. Not to mention the negative health effects from breathing it in...
records.en_auxiliary: Opening a window would end up with your face stained black. Not to mention the negative health effects from breathing it in...
records.en: Opening a window would end up with your face stained black.<CR>Not to mention the negative health effects from breathing it in...

records.jp: うわー。懐かしそうどころじゃなかったー
records.en_original: Yeesh... That doesn't sound nice at all!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeesh... That doesn't sound nice at all!
records.en: Yeesh... That doesn't sound nice at all!

records.jp: 古い恋愛映画で観たことある！<CR>衣装も素敵で、ロマンチックだったなぁ……
records.en_original: I've seen them in old romance flicks! The costumes were all so pretty...
records.en_auxiliary: I've seen them in old romance flicks! The costumes were all so pretty...
records.en: I've seen them in old romance flicks!<CR>The costumes were all so pretty...

records.jp: 私も古い映画で観たことがあります。<CR>車内で殺人事件が起きる映画でした
records.en_original: I've seen them in movies as well. One of them had a murder take place on the train.
records.en_auxiliary: I've seen them in movies as well. One of them had a murder take place on the train.
records.en: I've seen them in movies as well.<CR>One of them had a murder take place on the train.

records.jp: 当時の映画は、殺人描写が控えめだなと思いました
records.en_original: I remember thinking they were quite conservative when showing the murders.
records.en_auxiliary: I remember thinking they were quite conservative when showing the murders.
records.en: I remember thinking they were quite conservative when showing the murders.

records.jp: 殺人描写が控えめ！？
records.en_original: You wanted more?!
records.en_auxiliary: You wanted more?!
records.en: You thought the murder scenes were tame!?

records.jp: あ……すみません。つい……
records.en_original: Ah... I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...
records.en: Ah... I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...

records.jp: あはは……ま、趣味は人それぞれだし？
records.en_original: Haha... Well, people have different interests, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Haha... Well, people have different interests, right?
records.en: Haha... Well, people have different interests, right?

records.jp: 何だか、私の話がつまらなかったようで、<CR>すみません……
records.en_original: I'm sorry, that wasn't very interesting, was it?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry, that wasn't very interesting, was it?
records.en: I'm sorry, that wasn't very interesting,<CR>was it?

records.jp: や、私が物知らずなのが悪いだけだから！
records.en_original: N-no, it's my bad for being clueless!
records.en_auxiliary: N-no, it's my bad for being clueless!
records.en: N-no, it's my bad for being clueless!

records.jp: せっかく詩さんが話してくれたんだから、<CR>もっといろいろ知ってればよかったよ……
records.en_original: I wish I was a little smarter so I could keep up with you...
records.en_auxiliary: I wish I was a little smarter so I could keep up with you...
records.en: Since you went to the trouble of telling me about it,<CR>Uta-san, I wish I knew more...

records.jp: 詩さんは、やっぱ歴史を感じるから<CR>こういう古い感じのものが好きなの？
records.en_original: Do you like historical stuff like this, Uta?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you like historical stuff like this, Uta?
records.en: Do you like historical stuff like this,<CR>Uta-san?

records.jp: 歴史や古いものというか……小説や生身の人より、<CR>無機物なものの方が、気は楽でした
records.en_original: I suppose I do... I think I feel more at ease with inorganic things like this rather than things like books and people.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose I do... I think I feel more at ease with inorganic things like this rather than things like books and people.
records.en: It's not really about history or old things...<CR>I just felt more at ease with objects than with stories or living people.

records.jp: たぶん昔から、人や生き物と心を通わせるのが<CR>苦手だったんですね……
records.en_original: Perhaps I've always had a difficult time connecting with people and their emotions...
records.en_auxiliary: Perhaps I've always had a difficult time connecting with people and their emotions...
records.en: Maybe I've always had trouble connecting<CR>with people and other living things...

records.jp: そっか。でも……<CR>それでもいいんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: Could be, but... I don't think there's any problem with that.
records.en_auxiliary: Could be, but... I don't think there's any problem with that.
records.en: Could be, but...<CR>I don't think there's any problem with that.

records.jp: いいん、ですか？<CR>でも……そのせいで……
records.en_original: You...think so? But, because of me...
records.en_auxiliary: You...think so? But, because of me...
records.en: You...think so?<CR>But, because of me...

records.jp: この街燈を見て、詩さんはいいなって思えるけど、<CR>何とも思わない人もいるわけじゃん？
records.en_original: You appreciate these lamps, but other people may not, right?
records.en_auxiliary: You appreciate these lamps, but other people may not, right?
records.en: You look at these streetlights and think they're nice,<CR>Uta-san, but some people don't feel anything, right?

records.jp: いいなって思う人の方がめっちゃ多かったらさ、<CR>きっと、何とも思わない人が変とか言われるんだ
records.en_original: I bet if most people thought they were cool, they'd call people who didn't like them weird.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet if most people thought they were cool, they'd call people who didn't like them weird.
records.en: I bet if most people thought they were cool,<CR>they'd call people who didn't like them weird.

records.jp: ……世の中は、多数決でできている、<CR>ということでしょうか？
records.en_original: You mean that most things in this world are determined by the thoughts of the majority?
records.en_auxiliary: You mean that most things in this world are determined by the thoughts of the majority?
records.en: You mean that most things in this world are determined<CR>by the thoughts of the majority?

records.jp: んー。そーいうとこはあるのかも
records.en_original: Mmm, I think that's probably true too.
records.en_auxiliary: Mmm, I think that's probably true too.
records.en: Mmm, I think that's probably true too.

records.jp: 私は超平凡人間だし、詩さんの気持ち、<CR>本当には分かってないかもしれないけど
records.en_original: I'm just a normal, average person, so I may not really understand how you feel.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm just a normal, average person, so I may not really understand how you feel.
records.en: I'm super ordinary,<CR>so I may not truly understand how you feel, Uta-san, but...

records.jp: この街燈が好きだって思う詩さんって、<CR>すっごく素敵だなーって思うよ
records.en_original: But I think it's great that there's something you know you like.
records.en_auxiliary: But I think it's great that there's something you know you like.
records.en: I think it's really wonderful that you can love these streetlights,<CR>Uta-san.

records.jp: ……私は、星崎さんがこの街燈を好きだと<CR>言ってくれたことが、とても嬉しいです
records.en_original: It makes me happy that you seem to like it as well.
records.en_auxiliary: It makes me happy that you seem to like it as well.
records.en: ...I'm very happy you said you like these streetlights,<CR>Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 今は？<CR>やっぱり苦手なままだって思う？
records.en_original: Do you still feel like you have trouble connecting with others?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you still feel like you have trouble connecting with others?
records.en: Do you still<CR>feel like you have trouble connecting with others?

records.jp: ごめん！　私、無神経だった！　いきなり<CR>苦手なことが得意になったら、苦労とかしないよね
records.en_original: Actually, don't answer that! Sorry, that was inconsiderate of me to ask.
records.en_auxiliary: Actually, don't answer that! Sorry, that was inconsiderate of me to ask.
records.en: Actually, don't answer that!<CR>Sorry, that was inconsiderate of me to ask.

records.jp: ふふ。謝らなくてもいいですよ
records.en_original: Hehe. You don't have to apologize.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe. You don't have to apologize.
records.en: Hehe. You don't have to apologize.

records.jp: ……そうですね。今でも苦手だと思います。<CR>でも、星崎さんは、理解しやすいかもしれません
records.en_original: I do still have trouble. But you're easy for me to understand, Ao.
records.en_auxiliary: I do still have trouble. But you're easy for me to understand, Ao.
records.en: I do still have trouble.<CR>But you're easy for me to understand, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: うっ。私って単純だったり？
records.en_original: Oof. Is it because I'm simple?
records.en_auxiliary: Oof. Is it because I'm simple?
records.en: Oof. Is it because I'm simple?

records.jp: いえ。思ったことをきちんと話してくれるので、<CR>とてもありがたいんです
records.en_original: No, it's because you say the things you are thinking. It's very helpful for me.
records.en_auxiliary: No, it's because you say the things you are thinking. It's very helpful for me.
records.en: No, it's because you say the things you are thinking.<CR>It's very helpful for me.

records.jp: そ、そっか。よかった
records.en_original: Ah, I see. What a relief!
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I see. What a relief!
records.en: Ah, I see. What a relief!

records.jp: よかったら、これからも、いろいろなことを<CR>話してくださいね
records.en_original: I hope I can talk about all kinds of things with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope I can talk about all kinds of things with you.
records.en: If you don't mind, please keep telling me<CR>about all kinds of things.
